verdict.line: You lose extended trades before level 6 to Q poke and Deathbringer Stance sustain, and you win almost any fight from level 6 onward once R execute is up and his cooldowns are down.

brief.thesis: Aatrox out-trades Garen early because his Q (Darkin Blade) chain lets him dash in, hit, and dash out while his passive Deathbringer Stance empowers the next auto for bonus damage and healing that scales off your missing HP. Garen has no ranged answer to this and simply has to eat pokes until level 6, when R (Demacian Justice) deals true damage off current HP and erases the HP lead his sustain built. The matchup is decided by whether Garen can survive to 6 without falling behind on CS or HP, and whether he can catch Aatrox after Aatrox dumps his full Q-W-E chain without a kill.

theirWindow.when: Deathbringer Stance is lit and Q charges up
theirWindow.what: He is about to dash in for an empowered auto that heals him off your missing HP. Back off the wave or force him to waste it on a minion by not sitting at low HP near him.

yourWindow.when: He's burned all 3 Q charges and W chains with no kill
yourWindow.what: His mobility and CC are on full cooldown for roughly 9-14 seconds. Flash-in or just walk him down with Q (Decisive Strike) and E (Judgment) — he cannot disengage or stun you back.

start.why: Blocks his Q1 poke and minion harass so he can't chip you down before you ever get to trade.

boots.why: His entire damage profile is auto-attack based (Deathbringer Stance procs, on-hits), so flat AA damage reduction outvalues tenacity here.

core.why: The proc pairs with your empowered Q auto and E spin ticks for burst plus sustain that matches his own healing race.
Armor shred and haste let your spin-to-win outdamage his armor and Conditioning stacking.
The shield and tenacity buffer his W chain-stun into Q3 knockup combo so he can't chain you to zero.

he's snowballing crit or lifesteal items and his empowered autos are one-shotting you in trades
he's building heavy lifesteal to sustain through your all-ins
teamfights are dragging on and his R (World Ender) revive is winning extended 1v1s

runes.keystoneWhy: Extended trades and all-in duels are what decide this lane, and Conqueror's adaptive healing directly answers his own sustain race.

summoners.why: Flash lets you avoid his W (Infernal Chains) sweetspot stun or close the gap after he burns his combo; Teleport keeps you safe on wave since you can't contest his early poke range.

playing.title: Don't extend trades before level 6
playing.detail: Every extra auto exchange favors his Deathbringer Stance heal. Take one trade, disengage, and wait for a real opening.

playing.title: Activate W before he commits, not after
playing.detail: Courage's damage reduction needs to be up before his W-E-Q chain lands, not thrown on reactively once you're already at half HP.

playing.title: Count his Q charges
playing.detail: Track whether he's on Q1, Q2, or Q3 — the third cast knocks up. If he's already thrown two, either bait the knockup safely or disengage before it lands.

playing.title: All-in the instant his combo whiffs
playing.detail: If he dashes in with E and W and doesn't kill you, his kit is empty for several seconds. Walk him down immediately.

playing.title: Save R to erase his healing, not just for damage
playing.detail: Demacian Justice hits current HP as true damage, which cancels out the HP he clawed back from Deathbringer Stance and E lifesteal — don't waste it early just to secure a kill you'd get anyway.

playing.title: Farm under tower pre-6
playing.detail: Use Q's cooldown reset on takedowns/CS sparingly and prioritize not eating free pokes; you don't need lane dominance before 6, just HP parity.

playing.title: Buy anti-heal once the game passes 20 minutes
playing.detail: His passive and E sustain compound in longer fights, so a grievous wounds item becomes mandatory rather than optional.

brief.patchCaveat: Item and rune names reflect the last patch I have full detail on (League 16.x era Divine Sunderer / Black Cleaver / Conqueror builds for bruisers); verify current numbers and any mythic-system or rune-tree changes before locking the build in champ select.
